text: This waits for a person at Theorem to decide whether the AddressSanitizer exemption should be wider. The person decides whether the `asan` and `asan-ubsan` builds may link an object with these names uninstrumented, as a `rust-allocator-shim` entry in the `uninstrumented` list.
Not blocking: the docstring of `is_rust_allocator_symbol` says "a global function", but `is_rust_allocator_shim` calls it on every function of any binding (head `tools/check_links.py:825` and `846`).
